goal: SSRF review: server-side requests to URLs that users can influence.
use: SSRF review: server-side requests to URLs that users can influence. Use when code fetches a URL, host or address that comes from a request.

steps.note: Find the fetches. List each outbound request whose target can be influenced.
Check the allow-list. Flag requests to any host the caller names.
Check internal addresses. Flag requests that can reach private or metadata addresses.
Check redirects. Flag clients that follow redirects into internal hosts.
Report. Each request with file and line, severity and the fix.
